answer: Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 365 bonds yet holds one position, and the wharf report publishes the merged exposure. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, since the onyx funding graph is rebuilt from the mesa history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 365 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
